quote.text: I shall never be ashamed of citing a bad author if the line is good.
quote.author: seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Embrace wisdom wherever it arises—even from unlikely sources—as children do when they learn from every experience. Focus on the lesson, not the pedigree, to nurture open-minded growth.
    • Teach your children to value quality ideas over the reputation of the source; genuine truth and integrity shine through, regardless of its origin.
  • Leadership
    • As a leader, recognize that valuable insights can come from unexpected places; let merit be the measure, not titles or past judgments.
    • Adopt a mindset of humility and discernment: applaud good ideas even if they originate from sources you might otherwise dismiss, as each contributes to the common good.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, focus on the strength of the concept rather than its conventional source; effective solutions stand on their own and deserve recognition.
    • Adopt a results-oriented approach: evaluate strategies for their utility and impact rather than their traditional pedigree, ensuring that innovation leads the way.
